Notes.Text:
This update for java-11-openjdk fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-60589: improve resource resolving (bsc#1275777).
- CVE-2026-61308: enhance HTTP connections (bsc#1275778).
- CVE-2026-70907: enhance TLS server (bsc#1275764).

Changes for java-11-openjdk:

- Upgrade to jdk-11.0.32.1+1 (August 2026 CSPU)
